name: IA SEO Generator
author: mediterraneaservices

sections.description:
Generate an AI/IA-ready llms.txt for AI SEO indexing — no root writes. Preview, copy, download or serve /llms.txt dynamically.

IA SEO Generator (Free-LW) outputs a clear structure with header metadata (site, site_name, ISO date, language) and Pages/Posts sections (Title, URL, Updated, Excerpt). Includes preview, copy, download, a manual llms.txt language selector (EN/ES), and the option to serve dynamic /llms.txt (save Permalinks once). The admin UI uses English base and is i18n-ready for GlotPress language packs.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Go to IA SEO Generator → click Generate & view.
  3. Optional: serve dynamic /llms.txt by saving Permalinks once (Settings → Permalinks → Save).
sections.faq:
Why doesn’t it write the file in the root?

Due to WordPress.org policies. This plugin offers safe alternatives: dynamic endpoint, download and copy.

How do I enable dynamic /llms.txt?

Settings → Permalinks → Save (no changes needed). Then visit /llms.txt on your site.

Can I force Spanish or English in llms.txt independently of the UI?

Yes. Use the selector llms.txt language (Auto / EN / ES).
